title: Dell Alienware Command Center (AWCC), versions prior to 6.14.105.0, contain an Incorrect Default… (CVE-2026-111514)
description: Dell Alienware Command Center (AWCC) versions prior to 6.14.105.0 have an incorrect default permissions vulnerability. This flaw allows a low privileged local attacker to potentially execute arbitrary code and elevate privileges. The vulnerability is rated high severity with a CVSS score of 7.3.
